title: AI Instagram Comment Replies with RAG and Spam Filtering
summary: Reads comments on Instagram posts, understands intent, and replies like a person, using live event data and safety filters.
headline: Instagram comments, answered like a human would
problem: A large volume of comments needed fast, accurate, friendly replies, and spam and abusive comments had to be handled safely.
solution: A webhook receives each comment. The workflow checks sentiment and intent, flags spam and aggression with guardrails, escalates support requests, retrieves matching events by semantic search and writes a humanised reply with an OpenAI model.
highlights: Humanised replies grounded in retrieved data
role: Sole engineer. I designed the logic and prompts and built the whole workflow.

results.label: Less manual moderation and support effort
